cover_caption: Figure 1: Overview . T-Rex is a tactile-reactive dexterous manipulation framework that combines large-scale human egocentric pre-training with tactile-grounded robot mid-training. Built on a Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts (MoT) architecture, the T-Rex Model integrates low-frequency visuomotor planning with high-frequency tactile refinement and employs a spatial-temporal tactile encoder. The T-Rex Dataset introduces 100 hours of real robot data containing diverse motor primitives and object interactions with synchronized tactile signals as well as 12 manipulation tasks.

figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview . T-Rex is a tactile-reactive dexterous manipulation framework that combines large-scale human egocentric pre-training with tactile-grounded robot mid-training. Built on a Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts (MoT) architecture, the T-Rex Model integrates low-frequency visuomotor planning with high-frequency tactile refinement and employs a spatial-temporal tactile encoder. The T-Rex Dataset introduces 100 hours of real robot data containing diverse motor primitives and object interactions with synchronized tactile signals as well as 12 manipulation tasks.
figures.caption_ko: 그림 1: 개요. T-Rex는 대규모 인간 1인칭 시점 사전학습과 촉각에 기반한 로봇 중간학습을 결합하는 촉각 반응형 정교한 조작 프레임워크다. Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts(MoT) 아키텍처를 바탕으로, T-Rex 모델은 저주파 시각·운동 계획과 고주파 촉각 보정을 통합하고 시공간 촉각 인코더를 사용한다. T-Rex 데이터셋은 동기화된 촉각 신호를 포함하는 다양한 기본 동작과 물체 상호작용의 실제 로봇 데이터 100시간 및 12가지 조작 과제를 제공한다.

figures.caption: Figure 2: Statistics of the T-Rex Dataset. Top-left: distribution of object categories. Top-right: distribution of motor primitives. Bottom: long-tail distribution of individual objects. T-Rex dataset contains 100 hours of tactile-synchronized bimanual manipulation mid-training data spanning 200+ daily objects and 22 motor primitives, designed for broad coverage of contact-rich interactions.
figures.caption_ko: 그림 2: T-Rex 데이터셋 통계. 왼쪽 위: 물체 범주 분포. 오른쪽 위: 기본 동작 분포. 아래: 개별 물체의 롱테일 분포. T-Rex 데이터셋은 접촉이 많은 상호작용을 폭넓게 포괄하도록 설계되었으며, 200개 이상의 일상 물체와 22가지 기본 동작을 아우르는 촉각 동기화 양손 조작 중간학습 데이터 100시간을 포함한다.

figures.caption: Figure 3: T-Rex Model Architecture. T-Rex uses a Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts (MoT) backbone with three experts: a latent expert for future visual prediction, an action expert for low-frequency action denoising, and a tactile expert for high-frequency tactile refinement. During inference, the tactile expert reuses cached visual-language context to asynchronously refine intermediate actions using spatial-temporal tactile features, enabling fast tactile-reactive closed-loop control.
figures.caption_ko: 그림 3: T-Rex 모델 아키텍처. T-Rex는 세 전문가로 구성된 Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts(MoT) 백본을 사용한다. 미래 시각 예측을 위한 잠재 전문가, 저주파 행동 노이즈 제거를 위한 행동 전문가, 고주파 촉각 보정을 위한 촉각 전문가다. 추론 중 촉각 전문가는 캐시된 시각·언어 문맥을 재사용하며 시공간 촉각 특징으로 중간 행동을 비동기적으로 보정하여 빠른 촉각 반응형 폐루프 제어를 가능하게 한다.

figures.caption: Figure 4: Ablation Studies on Cascaded Denoising Split Steps K_{\mathrm{slow}} . We show the success rate curve of different split steps.
figures.caption_ko: 그림 4: 연쇄 노이즈 제거의 분할 단계 K_slow에 대한 절제 실험. 서로 다른 분할 단계에 따른 성공률 곡선을 제시한다.

figures.caption: Figure 5: Data Efficiency of T-Rex. We show the success rate curve of different numbers of demonstrations. Blue: with our tactile-grounded T-Rex mid-training data; Green: without mid-training.
figures.caption_ko: 그림 5: T-Rex의 데이터 효율. 시연 수에 따른 성공률 곡선을 제시한다. 파란색: 촉각에 기반한 T-Rex 중간학습 데이터를 사용한 경우. 초록색: 중간학습을 하지 않은 경우.

figures.caption: Figure 6: Ablation Studies on Mid-training Datasets. We select 6 representative tasks for post training evaluation and 4 easier tasks for zero-shot evaluation, including motor primitives of pick, slide, press and wipe in T-Rex dataset.
figures.caption_ko: 그림 6: 중간학습 데이터셋에 대한 절제 실험. 후속학습 평가를 위해 대표 과제 6개를, 제로샷 평가를 위해 더 쉬운 과제 4개를 선택했다. 후자는 T-Rex 데이터셋의 집기, 밀기, 누르기, 닦기 기본 동작을 포함한다.

figures.caption: Figure 7: Robot system setup on the Dexmate Vega-1 bimanual robot and the Sharpa Wave dexterous hands. ai_summary.one_liner: A variable-rate three-expert VLA combines human-video priors with tactile mid-training and fast tactile action refinement.
ai_summary.problem: Vision-dominated action chunks react too slowly to contact changes, while tactile encoders and training datasets often lack temporal and interaction diversity.
ai_summary.solution: 100 hours of synchronized tactile robot mid-training, temporal force VQ-VAE plus deformation encoding, and asynchronous cascaded flow matching with cached visual-language context.
ai_summary.key_result: Table 1 reports a 65% average progress-based task score across 12 tasks versus 35% for EgoScale (+30 percentage points); each task uses 16 evaluation rollouts.
limitations: Long-horizon tasks with tight tolerances remain difficult to demonstrate and execute.
Sensor distortion, calibration drift, and missing dense palm sensing constrain transfer.
Evaluation is concentrated on one robot/sensor platform and awards partial task completion.

relations.note: Section 4.3 follows the EgoScale human-video pretraining and robot adaptation recipe.
Cited prior force-aware VLA work; T-Rex adds temporal fingertip sensing and asynchronous refinement.
Both learn tactile representations for contact-rich dexterous control; this edge is a thematic comparison.
Both address tactile control of thin objects, including paper; this is not a claim of methodological inheritance.
Human-to-robot skill transfer and tactile representation provide complementary perspectives on sensor generalization.

research_gaps.question: How can online correction or reinforcement learning improve long-horizon, tight-tolerance manipulation beyond teleoperated behavior cloning?
How can tactile representations transfer across sensor calibration, hardware, and fingertip-versus-palm coverage?
Does the improvement persist across robot embodiments and longer runs when full completion is reported separately from partial progress?

future_directions.direction: Combine imitation learning with reinforcement learning or online corrective feedback for difficult contact transitions.
Develop unified tactile representations for heterogeneous sensors and extend sensing coverage to the palm.
Evaluate across embodiments with full-completion rates, partial-progress scores, and uncertainty reported separately.

next_reading.reason: EgoScale provides the human-video pretraining and robot-transfer basis used by T-Rex.
Compare force-aware VLA fusion with T-Rex’s temporal tactile representation and fast refinement.
Study cross-sensor tactile alignment as a possible route toward the transfer limitation identified by T-Rex.
